keyPlayers.name: Austin Smotherman
keyPlayers.hook: 63-62-65, 190, 23 under. Led by one after 54 holes.

headline: Smotherman led by one at 23 under after 54 holes. No winner.
whyCareReason: 63-62-65 for 190, a 54-hole scoring record. The final round is under way and this card does not crown a winner.
teaser: PGA and AP: Smotherman 190, Ghim 191, Crowe, James and Streelman 195.
story: Through 54 holes at Black Desert Resort, Ivins, par 71, Austin Smotherman led the Bank of Utah Championship by one at 23 under, 63-62-65, 190. That is the 54-hole scoring record. The previous mark was 194, Matt McCarty in 2024. It was his 100th PGA Tour start and he is still seeking a first win, after a 12-foot birdie on 18. Doug Ghim shot 65-62-64, 191, 22 under, also seeking a first win on his 192nd start. Tied third at 195: Trace Crowe 66-65-64, Ben James 65-66-64, Kevin Streelman 63-64-68. The purse is $6,000,000. The final round was in progress when this desk closed. Moving Sunday numbers are not printed.
stakes: A first PGA Tour win is still unclaimed on this page.
rivalryAngle: 100th start, one shot clear after 54, and the final round is not a result.
